installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CalagopusStats Modern Installation Script
# Server Files: /mnt/server

# ANSI Color Codes
RESET="\e[0m"
BLACK_BRIGHT="\e[90m"
CYAN_BRIGHT="\e[96m"
GREEN="\e[32m"
GREEN_BRIGHT="\e[92m"
YELLOW_BRIGHT="\e[93m"
RED="\e[31m"
RED_BRIGHT="\e[91m"
CYAN="\e[36m"
WHITE="\e[97m"

# Print helper functions matching logger.js style
format_time() {
    echo -e "${BLACK_BRIGHT}[$(date +"%H:%M:%S")]${RESET}"
}

log_prefix() {
    echo -e "$(format_time) ${BLACK_BRIGHT}│${RESET} ${CYAN_BRIGHT}CalagopusStats${RESET}"
}

log_info() {
    echo -e "$(log_prefix) ${CYAN}ℹ${RESET} ${WHITE}$1${RESET}"
}

log_success() {
    echo -e "$(log_prefix) ${GREEN}✔${RESET} ${GREEN_BRIGHT}$1${RESET}"
}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "$(log_prefix) ${YELLOW_BRIGHT}⚠${RESET} ${YELLOW_BRIGHT}$1${RESET}"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "$(log_prefix) ${RED}✖${RESET} ${RED_BRIGHT}$1${RESET}"
}

log_system() {
    echo -e "$(log_prefix) ${CYAN}⚡${RESET} ${CYAN_BRIGHT}$1${RESET}"
}

# Helper function to run a command and log output on failure
run_cmd() {
    local cmd="$1"
    local desc="$2"
    
    log_system "$desc..."
    eval "$cmd" > /tmp/install.log 2>&1
    local status=$?
    
    if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then
        log_error "Failed: $desc"
        echo -e "${RED_BRIGHT}Error log output:${RESET}"
        cat /tmp/install.log
        exit $status
    fi
}

# Clear and draw intro
clear
echo -e ""
echo -e "    ${CYAN_BRIGHT}_CalagopusStats__________    ______   ______   ${RESET}"
echo -e "   ${CYAN_BRIGHT}/\\\\\\\\  ___\\\\\\\\  /\\\\\\\\__  _\\\\\\\\ /\\\\\\\\  __ \\\\\\\\  /\\\\\\\\__  _\\\\\\\\ /\\\\\\\\  ___\\\\\\\\  ${RESET}"
echo -e "   ${CYAN_BRIGHT}\\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\___  \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\/_ \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\/ \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\_\\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\/_/\\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\/ \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\___  \\\\\\\\ ${RESET}"
echo -e "    ${CYAN_BRIGHT}\\\\\\\\/\\\\\\\\_____\\\\\\\\   \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\_\\\\\\\\  \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\_\\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\_\\\\\\\\   \\\\\\\\ \\\\\\\\_\\\\\\\\  \\\\\\\\/\\\\\\\\_____\\\\\\\\ ${RESET}"
echo -e "     ${CYAN_BRIGHT}\\\\\\\\/_____/    \\\\\\\\/_/   \\\\\\\\/_/\\\\\\\\/_/    \\\\\\\\/_/   \\\\\\\\/_____/${RESET}"
echo -e "  ${BLACK_BRIGHT}───────────────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
echo -e "             ${CYAN_BRIGHT}Calagopus Installation Agent${RESET}"
echo -e "  ${BLACK_BRIGHT}───────────────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
echo -e ""

log_system "Starting installation process"

# 1. Update apt repositories
run_cmd "apt update -y" "Updating system package repositories"
log_success "Package repositories updated."

# 2. Install dependencies
run_cmd "apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip libtool" "Installing build essentials & system dependencies"
log_success "System dependencies installed successfully."

# 3. Update npm globally
run_cmd "npm install npm@latest --location=global" "Updating global npm version"
log_success "npm updated to latest version."

# 4. Repository setup (Reinstall safe)
log_system "Setting up server directory..."
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
    run_cmd "git fetch --all && git reset --hard origin/main" "Existing repository found. Updating source code"
else
    run_cmd "git clone https://github.com/heyitslumi/CalagopusStats.git ." "Cloning CalagopusStats repository"
fi
log_success "Repository setup complete."

# 5. Installing node packages
if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
    run_cmd "/usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}" "Installing user-specified additional npm packages"
fi

if [ -f package.json ]; then
    run_cmd "/usr/local/bin/npm install --production --no-audit --no-fund" "Installing production node dependencies"
    log_success "Production dependencies installed."
else
    log_warn "package.json not found in /mnt/server!"
fi

echo -e ""
echo -e "  ${BLACK_BRIGHT}───────────────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
log_success "CalagopusStats installation completed successfully!"
echo -e "  ${BLACK_BRIGHT}───────────────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
echo -e ""

exit 0
